title: Highway realignment crossing 17 archaeological sites
summary: The commission deferred its review of the archaeological inventory survey plan for a highway realignment to August 6th without a vote, because too few eligible members could act. The planned route crosses 17 known archaeological sites. The highway presentation will be linked on the agenda.
